API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIAdmin and Role ManagementAdd Role
Add Role
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/adminRoles

Creates an admin role.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

Admin role ID.

rank
int32

Admin rank of this admin role. This is applicable only when admin rank is enabled in the advanced settings. Default value is 7 (the lowest rank). The assigned admin rank determines the roles or admin users this user can manage, and which rule orders this admin can access.

name
string

Name of the role.

policyAccess
string

Policy access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

alertingAccess
string

Alerting access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

dashboardAccess
string

Dashboard access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

reportAccess
string

Report access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

analysisAccess
string

Insights logs access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

usernameAccess
string

Username access permission. When set to NONE, the username is obfuscated.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

deviceInfoAccess
string

Device information access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

adminAcctAccess
string

Admin and role management access permission.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

isAuditor
boolean

Indicates whether this is an auditor role.

permissions
string[]

List of functional areas to which this role has access. This attribute is subject to change.

Possible values: [USER_ACCESS, SECURE, MANAGE, COMPLY, SSL_POLICY, ADVANCED_SETTINGS, TRAFFIC_FORWARDING, AUTHENTICATION_CONFIGURATION, FIREWALL_DNS, NSS_CONFIGURATION, VZEN_CONFIGURATION, LOCATIONS, HOSTED_PAC_FILES, EZ_AGENT_CONFIGURATIONS, SECURE_AGENT_NOTIFICATIONS, VPN_CREDENTIALS, PROXY_GATEWAY, STATIC_IPS, GRE_TUNNELS, SUBCLOUDS, AUTHENTICATION_SETTINGS, IDENTITY_PROXY_SETTINGS, USER_MANAGEMENT, APIKEY_MANAGEMENT, PARTNER_INTEGRATION, POLICY_RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT, CUSTOM_URL_CAT, OVERRIDE_EXISTING_CAT, TENANT_PROFILE_MANAGEMENT, CLIENT_CONNECTOR_PORTAL, CUSTOMER_ACCT_INFO, CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTION, CUSTOMER_ORG_SETTINGS, REMOTE_ASSISTANCE_MANAGEMENT, ZDX_CONFIGURATION, ZDX_EXECUTIVE_INSIGHTS, ZDX_ADMIN_MANAGEMENT, ZDX_USER_DEVICE_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_DASHBOARD, ZDX_ALERTS, ZDX_LTSESSION, ZDX_WEBHOOKS, ZDX_ONBOARDING, ZDX_INTERNAL, ZDX_UCAAS, ZDX_UCAAS_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_MA_ACCESS, ZDX_CLIENT_APPS, ZDX_ADMIN_SETTINGS, ZDX_DEVICE_INVENTORY, ZDX_YENGINE_SVC, ZDX_DASHBOARD_PERF, ZDX_DASHBOARD_APP_OVERVIEW, ZDX_DASHBOARD_APP_DASHBOARD, ZDX_DASHBOARD_USER_OVERVIEW, ZDX_DASHBOARD_USER_DASHBOARD, ZDX_USER_SEARCH_ACCESS, ZDX_USER_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_LOCATION_ACCESS, ZDX_DEVICE_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_IP_ADDRESS_ACCESS, ZDX_UCAAS_CONFIGURATION, ZDX_UCAAS_MEETING, ZDX_UCAAS_APPLICATION, ZDX_TIME_DURATION, ZDX_EPT, ZDX_YENGINE_ANALYSIS, ZDX_PCAP_CAPTURE, EDGE_CONNECTOR_DASHBOARD, EDGE_CONNECTOR_CLOUD_PROVISIONING, EDGE_CONNECTOR_ADMIN_MANAGEMENT, EDGE_CONNECTOR_LOCATION_MANAGEMENT, EDGE_CONNECTOR_FORWARDING, EDGE_CONNECTOR_NSS_CONFIGURATION, EDGE_CONNECTOR_TEMPLATE, CSPM_CONFIGURATION, DEVICE_NAME_ACCESS, ZSCALER_DECEPTION_PORTAL]

featurePermissions
object
isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates whether this admin user is editable.

logsLimit
string

Log range limit.

Possible values: [UNRESTRICTED, MONTH_1, MONTH_2, MONTH_3, MONTH_4, MONTH_5, MONTH_6]

roleType
string

The admin role type. (This attribute is subject to change.)

Possible values: [ANY, ORG_ADMIN, SDWAN, MSFT_VIRTUAL_WAN, PUBLIC_API, EXEC_INSIGHT, EXEC_INSIGHT_AND_ORG_ADMIN, ZDX_ADMIN, EDGE_CONNECTOR_ADMIN, CSPM_ADMIN, ZSCALER_DECEPTION_ADMIN, ZSCALER_DECEPTION_SUPER_ADMIN]

featurePermissionsFromJson
string

Feature access permission from JSON.

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
